summary: Amazon demand is existing search demand.
Prefer stable 12-month demand, attackable competition, healthy price floor, and FBA-safe economics.
Reject capital-heavy, restricted, viral-unproven, price-war, brand-locked, and review-wall products.
DTC has two subroutes with different economics: paid ads and SEO.
DTC ad products need high gross margin, a 3-second hook, and sustained ad validation.
DTC SEO products need searchable buyer-intent problems, weak SERPs, evergreen demand, and can accept lower gross margin.
Use the small-seller threshold matrix: avoid pure red oceans, capital barriers, and brand-locked categories.
Prefer skill/execution barriers that can be won through differentiation, listing, bundle, content, or creative work.
Apply universal red lines before scoring: battery, liquid, fragile-heavy, IP risk, forced certification, high MOQ, strong seasonality, and unproven viral demand.
